create.title: Fixed-scale character-Abel bound for the physical upper endpoint
create.statement_tex: Let Q_j(h)=Xh/D_j^2 and let a_(j,h)(q)=q^(-3/4)W(2sqrt(Q_j(h)/q)) times the actual top one-jump star when j=0 and the product-prefix star at hq=N_X. For every active D_j=2^(-j)floor(sqrt X) and 1<=h<=H_j=floor(D_jX^(-1/4)), one has ||a_(j,h)||_infinity+sum_q|a_(j,h)(q+1)-a_(j,h)(q)| <<_W Q_j(h)^(-3/4). Since sup_T|sum_(q<=T)chi_4(q)|<=1, discrete Abel summation gives sum_q chi_4(q)a_(j,h)(q)<<_W Q_j(h)^(-3/4). The product cutoff is automatic on profile support apart from its half tie. This statement is for the accepted physical symmetric-profile limit, not arbitrary finite top Mellin truncations.
create.next_action: Use only after the accepted physical profile limit; do not infer uniform sampled BV for a finite top Mellin truncation.

update.reason_for_promotion: Three independent Round-23 derivations prove uniform fixed-scale sampled BV, period-four chi_4 Abel cancellation, the full height/scale sum, and the correct physical normalization with all top, product, star, and floor seams retained.
update.statement_tex: In the accepted physical symmetric-profile limit, with N_X=floor(16sqrt X), every actual dyadic scale D_j=2^(-j)floor(sqrt X), height H_j=floor(D_jX^(-1/4)), Vaaler factor, hard-top star, and product half tie retained, one has sum_(hq<=N_X)^* chi_4(q)(hq)^(-3/4)H^prof_(infinity,X)(h,q)<<_W 1. After restoring the external active-M1 factor, the upper radial endpoint is O_W(X^(1/4)). The proof is fixed-scale Abel summation in q and does not assert a uniform finite-top-Mellin-truncation bound.
update.next_action: Treat the physical upper endpoint as target-safe. Keep finite top Mellin truncations outside this lemma and attack the recombined R_1 arithmetic residue and diagonal transition traces separately.

update.statement_tex: For M=1, finite Cauchy algebra returns the terminal-plus-side endpoint operator to original-sector right-line Perron prefixes minus the arithmetic and artificial residue shares. Both physical radial prefixes are now target-safe: the lower by the direct profile bound and the upper by fixed-scale chi_4 Abel summation. The arithmetic ledger still recombines to R^ar[R_1], and the two diagonal transition traces remain separate and open; control these before declaring the full endpoint/vector operator closed.
update.next_action: Derive and estimate the recombined R_1 arithmetic residue in exact physical profile variables, keeping both diagonal transition traces separate.

reject.reason: At finite top Mellin height the inverse top profile has noncompact Perron tails, and no uniform sampled-q BV bound for that intermediate kernel has been proved. The accepted lemma begins after the physical symmetric-profile limit.
